summary: PANDA Radboud-style fine Gleason annotation contract with provider-specific provenance and protected unknown/background.

annotation_traits: Radboud masks encode background/unknown, stroma, benign epithelium, and Gleason patterns 3, 4, and 5
Karolinska masks use a different coarse annotation convention
the public challenge includes incomplete, sparse, and noisy annotations
semantic_limitations: This profile is only valid for a verified Radboud-style fine mask; Karolinska binary cancer annotations are not interchangeable.
Background/unknown cannot be interpreted as benign stroma or available tissue.
Necrosis, immune, vessel, and other-tissue compartments are not separately encoded.

rules.claim: Enforce the compiler-bound profile_required_provenance execution invariant.
rules.required_observation: Use only the typed observation_authority records; no unannotated histologic structure observation is authorized.
known_limitations: The current provenance checker verifies presence; a certified profile router must additionally validate allowed provider values.

rules.claim: Enforce the compiler-bound background_seed_protection execution invariant.
rules.required_observation: Use only the typed observation_authority records; no unannotated histologic structure observation is authorized.
known_limitations: An unlabeled H&E region may contain tissue; this profile still cannot authorize editing it.

rules.claim: A Gleason label represents tumor architecture, not merely tumor presence or mask color; local H&E must support the retained pattern.
rules.required_observation: Counterfactual histology may be inspected only after generation in reader-only QA; this fact is unavailable to execution selection or veto.
exceptions: A burden-only boundary displacement may retain the existing fine label only where adjacent H&E resembles the same component.
counterexamples: Extending Gleason 3 over a solid H&E focus.
Extending Gleason 5 into a field of separate well-formed glands.
expected_morphology: Pattern 4: fused, poorly formed, cribriform, or glomeruloid architecture.
Pattern 5: solid sheets, cords, single cells, or comedonecrosis.
forbidden_morphology: A fine label expanded across visibly incompatible architecture.
known_limitations: Architectural assessment needs sufficient H&E resolution and expert validation.
Reader-only pathology facts are excluded from the execution knowledge bundle.
